findings.description: Friedrich Carl Weber and Catharina Carell had a daughter, Anna Maria Eva Weber, born 26 February 1870, baptized 13 March 1870 in Höchst, Hesse-Nassau — one baptism, attested by the parish Kirchenbuch and its Kirchenbuchduplikat, both naming parents Karl Weber and Katharina Karell. She is not the couple's first known child — an earlier daughter, Rosina, was baptized 3 May 1869 in Nied, naming the same parents (Carl Friedrich Weber and Catharina Karel).
